ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low internal ratio; surface is predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to fine-grain noise and linear abrasions against a high-intensity background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of contiguous white geometric blobs; surface exhibits a uniform dark distribution interrupted only by narrow, high-contrast linear streaks (scratches) mapped across the medial and lateral lobe sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 40 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; trailing edge contains at least 12 distinct jagged peaks on the right lobe and a highly irregular, fragmented topography on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins with an upward-sloping sweep; the trajectory is interrupted by significant edge erosion on the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) present on both lobes, exhibiting varying lengths and orientations across the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe shows significant structural irregularity and potential tissue loss/amputation, resulting in a non-symmetrical profile compared to the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'shredded' pixel profile on the trailing edge of the left lobe, creating a unique sawtooth-like silhouette distinct from standard serration patterns.
